channel.title: New Straits Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from New Straits Times (nst.com.my)

item.title: Stronger reforms needed to end tuberculosis threat
item.description: LETTER: When news emerged of a tuberculosis (TB) cluster involving several children in Johor, many were shocked.

item.title: Grandmother mourns boy lost to strong currents at Johor beach
item.description: KOTA TINGGI: What started as a family outing ended in tragedy when 11-year-old Putra Aniq Fairuz Mohd Faizul drowned at Pantai Tanjung Buloh, despite relatives believing all children had returned safely to shore.

item.title: Gold rises from one-week low ahead of FOMC minutes
item.description: NEW YORK: Gold prices rose on Wednesday, rebounding from a one-week low hit in the previous session as markets await the release of the Federal Reserve's January meeting minutes for hints about the rate-cut outlook.

item.title: Microsoft says it is on pace to invest US$50bil in 'Global South' AI push
item.description: NEW YORK: Microsoft on Wednesday said it is on pace to invest US$50 billion by the end of the decade to help expand artificial intelligence (AI) to countries across the 'Global South'.

item.title: Aaron-Wooi seek German Open high ahead of All England mission
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Top seeds Aaron Chia-Soh Wooi Yik will use next week’s German Open as a final litmus test to sharpen their form ahead of the All England on March 3-8.

item.title: Elderly woman killed while crossing Darul Aman Highway in Alor Star
item.description: ALOR STAR: An elderly pedestrian died today after she was run over by a car crossing the Darul Aman Highway here.

item.title: 65 illegal smuggling stores still operating along Kelantan–Thailand border - Cops
item.description: KOTA BARU: The General Operations Force has found 65 illegal stores along the Malaysia–Thailand border that are still operating and involved in various illicit activities.

item.title: Kuantan murder-suicide: Grief in the air as relatives wait to claim bodies
item.description: KUANTAN: Relatives of the five family members found dead yesterday have begun arriving at the forensic department of Tengku Ampuan Afzan Hospital today.

item.title: Malaysia secure Thomas and Uber Cup Finals spots via world rankings
item.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia have officially secured their spots in the Thomas and Uber Cup Finals, scheduled to take place from April 24-May 3 in Horsens, Denmark.

item.title: Pregnant woman buried with unborn child after suspected murder
item.description: KOTA TINGGI: A pregnant Rohingya woman, allegedly killed by her husband in a domestic dispute last Friday, was buried today with her unborn child.
